answer: The cheapest real defence: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because plume only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, wharf is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any crystal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
